<image>
Identify municipal infrastructure hazards, drain choking, and litter in this CCTV frame.

Visual inspection reveals a severe storm drain intake obstruction located at the curb line [620, 140, 890, 480]. Heavy accumulation of post-consumer plastic wrappers, thermocol, and beverage containers has formed a blockage spanning 42% of the grating aperture. Water ponding depth is approximately 8-12 cm. Immediate mechanical dredging and desilting required.

<image>
Assess the sewer outfall level and backflow risk.

The CCTV frame captures critical river stage backflow at Deccan Gymkhana sluice gate [410, 220, 780, 860]. Water capacity threshold is exceeded at 86%, with floating organic debris impeding flap valve closure. Silt accumulation index is high. Risk of urban street flooding within 20 minutes if dewatering pumps are not engaged.

<image>
Detect municipal solid waste dumping and identify associated vehicle or pedestrian.

Unauthorized municipal solid waste dumping identified at road margin [180, 310, 520, 690]. Commercial cardboard packing and construction debris observed. Adjacent two-wheeler detected at [240, 720, 490, 940] involved in illegal disposal under Section 376 of Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act.

<image>
Evaluate water depth and traffic passability in the subway underpass.

Underpass sump basin exhibits critical waterlogging [550, 80, 980, 920] covering the entire two-lane roadway. Submerged curb indicates water depth exceeding 35 cm, rendering the route impassable for two-wheelers and light motor vehicles. Automated sump pump failure suspected; traffic diversion barricades should be immediately deployed.

<image>
Inspect box culvert intake for sediment and vegetative choking.

Box culvert throat is 65% obstructed by dense silt sediment and weed growth [630, 290, 870, 750]. Hydraulic cross-section is severely compromised ahead of monsoon downpours. High-pressure jetting suction unit dispatched for desilting.
